readings.Aries: The wound you keep reopening has something to teach. You've been treating the symptom. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Taurus: Something you own or have made is worth more than you've assigned it. Revalue. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Gemini: Your mind generates options at a rate that makes choosing feel like loss. It isn't. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Cancer: There is something in your environment that needs physical attention — a space, an object, a body. Attend to it. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Leo: You contain more generosity than you sometimes access. Today, go deeper. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Virgo: The person who doesn't appreciate your efforts — their appreciation was never the point. Reconnect with the actual point. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Libra: There is something you find beautiful about someone that you haven't told them. Tell them. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: You know something about someone that they don't know you know. Decide what to do with it carefully. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Sagittarius: You are more attached to the journey than to the destination, which is beautiful and occasionally inconvenient. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: You are further along than you think. The metric you're using is incorrect. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Aquarius: The thing you're resisting because it seems too normal — normal isn't the problem. Examine the actual resistance. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Pisces: There is more groundedness in you than your fluidness suggests. Access it today. Sleep on it before committing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
